title: Hurr ki surat jo
body:
hurr ki surat jo samajh mein kahin aa jaye hussain
ek ek saans sada dene lage haye hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
sar uthaata nahi sajde se khuda ka mehboob
aap hi pusht se jab tak na utar jaaye hussain
hurr ki surat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
maut bhi aayi to qadmon se uthi le ke hayaat
ban gayi khaake shifa khaake kaf e paaye hussain
hurr ki surat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ta hayaat ek ke baad ek pisar rahib ko
bakhshta jaye khuda kehta agar jaye hussain
hurr ki surat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
chod kar aa gaye kyun ran mein ali asghar ko
kis tarha banu e dilgeer ko samjhaye hussain
hurr ki surat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
shimr ne halq pe pyase ke jo khanjar rakha
kund khanjar se sada aane lagi haye hussain
hurr ki surat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ro ke zainab ne kaha kaise sambhalun dil ko
bekafan dekh ke tujhko mere maajaye hussain
hurr ki surat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
rakh ke sar sajda e mabood mein sarwar ne kaha
jo hai mansha e elaahi hai wo mansha e hussain
hurr ki surat jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
waasta de ke husain ibne ali ka maango
rad nahi karta khuda koi tamanna e hussain
hurr ki surat jo...
author: Sachey Bhai
